status: DRAFT by claude-2 at Joe's direction ("we may need some intermediate theses for me to make more immediate judgements ... and you too"); each one is a rule of judgement that sits between the apex thesis and a backlog row, and names the record that decides it

theses.text: A mission whose Place is down is not open work; it is rehomed or retired.
theses.decided-by: the Place probe (port, process, cron, file, host)

theses.text: A closure without an independent witness is a reading, not a completion.
theses.decided-by: a registry warrant, a cascade-real arrow, or a commit that produced the named artifact (C6: 0 of 12 live-gap closings had one)

theses.text: A held item is open only if the holder and the un-hold condition are both named.
theses.decided-by: the hold reason in the mission file; otherwise it is retired or merged

theses.text: Completed work is attested upward: every closure names the therefore it served and the witness, so the thesis box can count what has been done, not only what is open.
theses.decided-by: an attestation per closed row, rendered under its therefore

theses.text: The War Machine may select only from the set that survives IT-1 to IT-3 and names who acts.
theses.decided-by: the outermost loop's selectable count on this page
